```{r}
#| label: setup
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

snapshots <- tar_read(snapshots)
checks <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tar_read(checks))
bt <- tar_read(backtest)
params <- snapshots$params
current <- max(params$season)

c_power <- "#d1622a"; c_resume <- "#3a6ea5"; c_muted <- "#77756f"
theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title = element_text(color = c_muted))
```

## Convergence gates

Every weekly snapshot is fit with 4 chains × 1000 draws and must pass R̂ ≤ 1.01,
bulk/tail ESS ≥ 400, zero divergences and E-BFMI > 0.2. A failing fit is re-run once with a
longer warmup and `adapt_delta = 0.99`; the published current-season snapshot stops the
pipeline if it still fails.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gates
#| tbl-cap: "Gate results by season"
params |>
  group_by(Season = season) |>
  summarise(Snapshots = n(), Passed = sum(passed), `Needed retry` = sum(attempts > 1),
            `Worst R̂` = max(max_rhat), `Min ESS` = min(pmin(min_ess_bulk, min_ess_tail)),
            Divergences = sum(divergences), `Fit time (min)` = sum(seconds) / 60) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(`Worst R̂`, decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(c(`Min ESS`, `Fit time (min)`), decimals = 0)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-failed
failed <- params |> filter(!passed)
if (nrow(failed) > 0) {
  failed |>
    select(season, week_label, max_rhat, min_ess_bulk, min_ess_tail, divergences, min_ebfmi) |>
    gt(caption = "Snapshots that failed a gate after the retry") |>
    fmt_number(where(is.numeric), decimals = 3)
}
```

## Estimated structure

```{r}
#| label: fig-params
#| fig-cap: "Population-level parameters at each season's final snapshot."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
params |>
  group_by(season) |>
  filter(week == max(week)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(season, `Home field (pts)` = hfa, `Game noise σ (pts)` = sigma,
         `Preseason carry-over` = b_prev, `FCS offset (pts)` = fcs_offset) |>
  pivot_longer(-season) |>
  ggplot(aes(season, value)) +
  geom_line(color = c_power, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = c_power, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_report
```

## Posterior predictive checks

For each season's latest snapshot: does data simulated from the fitted model look like the real
games? A statistic well outside the 90% predictive interval points to misfit.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ppc
#| tbl-cap: "Observed statistic vs. 90% posterior predictive interval"
bind_rows(lapply(checks, \(x) x$ppc |> mutate(season = x$season))) |>
  mutate(ok = observed >= rep_lo & observed <= rep_hi) |>
  transmute(Season = season, Statistic = statistic, Observed = observed,
            Interval = sprintf("%.3f – %.3f", rep_lo, rep_hi), Inside = ifelse(ok, "✓", "✗")) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Statistic") |>
  fmt_number(Observed, decimals = 3)
```

## Prior sensitivity

Power-scaling sensitivity (`priorsense`): how much each posterior shifts when the prior or the
likelihood is strengthened or weakened. "prior-data conflict" or "weak likelihood" diagnoses
are worth a look; values below 0.05 are negligible.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sens
#| tbl-cap: "Current-season prior sensitivity"
cur <- checks[[as.character(current)]]
if (!is.null(cur) && "prior" %in% names(cur$sensitivity)) {
  cur$sensitivity |>
    select(variable, prior, likelihood, diagnosis) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_number(c(prior, likelihood), decimals = 3)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-loo
#| tbl-cap: "PSIS-LOO by season (joint margin + efficiency likelihood)"
bind_rows(lapply(checks, \(x) x$loo |> mutate(season = x$season, .before = 1))) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(-season, decimals = 1)
```

## Out-of-sample accuracy

Each game is predicted by the snapshot fitted through the previous week (week-1 games by the
preseason snapshot), so no result informs its own prediction. Vegas comparisons use the median
closing spread across books.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bt
#| tbl-cap: "Backtest summary"
bt$overall |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(scope = "", games = "Games", mae = "MAE", rmse = "RMSE", brier = "Brier",
             logloss = "Log loss", accuracy = "Winner %", games_with_line = "With line",
             mae_model_lined = "Model MAE (lined)", mae_vegas = "Vegas MAE", ats_win_rate = "ATS %") |>
  fmt_number(c(mae, rmse, mae_model_lined, mae_vegas), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(c(brier, logloss), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(c(accuracy, ats_win_rate), decimals = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bt-week
#| fig-cap: "Mean absolute error by week of season (FBS vs FBS), model vs. closing line."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
bt$by_week |>
  select(week, Model = mae_model_lined, `Vegas close` = mae_vegas) |>
  pivot_longer(-week) |>
  ggplot(aes(week, value, color = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Model = c_power, `Vegas close` = "#52514e"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Week predicted", y = "MAE (points)") +
  theme_report + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-calibration
#| fig-cap: "Calibration of pre-game win probabilities (all games)."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(bt$calibration, aes(pred, obs)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = c_muted) +
  geom_line(color = c_power, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = c_power) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Predicted home win probability", y = "Observed") +
  coord_equal() + theme_report
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bt-season
#| tbl-cap: "Backtest by season (FBS vs FBS)"
bt$by_season |>
  select(season, games, mae, mae_model_lined, mae_vegas, accuracy, brier, ats_win_rate) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(season = "Season", games = "Games", mae = "MAE", mae_model_lined = "Model MAE (lined)",
             mae_vegas = "Vegas MAE", accuracy = "Winner %", brier = "Brier", ats_win_rate = "ATS %") |>
  fmt_number(c(mae, mae_model_lined, mae_vegas), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(brier, decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(c(accuracy, ats_win_rate), decimals = 1)
```
